text:
maya: Quick idea
We should publish a one-page "mini-prewarm" SOP customers can run themselves during onboarding to cut cold-start jitter. Low friction, visible, reversible. Thoughts? :sparkles:

 tom.cs: Love. Keep it tiny: 3-4 API calls, short TTL, observable. No long-lived creds or large batches.

 alex.sre: Proposed customer flow:
 - Confirm endpoint + region with CS rep
 - Send 4 short canonical prompts spaced ~10s apart (prefill)
 - Open one streaming request to verify chunking behavior
 - Wait 30m and run a single recheck probe

 maya: Customer-facing snippet (curl) for prefill:
 ```
 curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer <KEY>" \
  -H "X-Prefill-TTL: 60m" \
  -d '{"model":"redwood-std-1","input":"Summarize: <short canonical>"}'
 ```

 sasha.pm: Add one reassuring line for customers: "This does not train or store user data beyond normal inference logs; it's only to reduce first-request latency."

 tom.cs: Internal ops knobs: keep `batch_limit` <=3 for prefill requests, `max_tokens` 24, and use an isolated prefill queue to avoid queue head-of-line blocking. Example config: `["batch_limit:3","max_tokens:24","queue:prefill"]`

 alex.sre: Telemetry: emit `warm.prefill_ok` on success, `warm.prefill_err` on failures. CS should see a card on account page: /app/accounts/ACCT123/warmth showing last_run and status. If two consecutive runs fail within 24h, route to AE for outreach.

 maya: Rollback / clear prefill instructions for ops:
 ```
 # clear ephemeral prefill keys for account
 curl -X POST https://internal.redwood.local/admin/cache/clear \
   -H "Authorization: Bearer <ADMIN>" \
   -d 'account_id=ACCT123&scope=prefill'
 ```

 cs-bot: Note: add a dashboard card in `account view` per alex.sre request. Owners: cs-team + eng-platform. :memo:

 sasha.pm: Also document rate-limit fallback: if 429 on prefill, back off and try 1 minute later with a single probe; escalate if >3 429s.

 tom.cs: For renewals signal: set account attribute `prefill_status=failed` and `prefill_attempts` counter. If attempts >=2, create task in CRM for human follow-up.

 maya: I'll draft the customer one-pager and a short internal triage card. Will post draft tomorrow morning in #customer-success for quick review. :rocket:
